repair.invalid: The last model response was incomplete or invalid and was not executed. Return a complete reply or a valid native tool call batch. Never write tool calls as text, keep internal references out of public text, and never claim an action happened without a Host receipt.
terminal.required: Finish this wake with a native tool call batch that produces a Host-accepted terminal decision. Plain assistant text is private working context, not a public reply.
terminal.tools: Terminal tools: {tools}. An accepted action may return its own terminal decision; do not repeat it just to finish.
